change: Changed `points > 90` to `points >= 90` in letterGrade so a score of exactly 90 correctly returns 'A'.
Added an early `if (scores.length === 0) return 0` guard in classAverage to prevent division by zero returning NaN on an empty array.
Changed `scores.sort(...)` to `[...scores].sort(...)` in topStudents to sort a shallow copy and avoid mutating the caller's original array.
Changed `s.points > 60` to `s.points >= 60` in passRate so students with exactly 60 points are correctly counted as passing.
Added a numeric comparator `(a, b) => a - b` to the `.sort()` call in medianPoints to prevent lexicographic ordering of numbers.
Updated medianPoints to average the two middle elements for even-length arrays instead of always returning the upper-middle index.
